A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same work. All 46 pages of each version, including Appendices A–H, are readable, and their text, equations, figures, and tables support reliable comparison.

before.justification: V2 reports original evaluations of three agent prototypes on COCO-Captions, ImageInWords, and DesignBench, human ratings, a 143-participant survey, and an image-filtering experiment.

after.justification: V3 retains these original empirical studies and reports revised, more detailed human-evaluation results in Table 1.

M1.justification: The belief graphs, belief transitions, and Ag1/Ag2/Ag3 question-selection procedures remain unchanged in Sections 4–6 and Appendix D. Algorithm 1 receives wording edits without changes to its steps.

E1.justification: Both versions use COCO-Captions, ImageInWords, and DesignBench for the same image-generation tasks and retain the same human-study scenarios. Newly reported ImageInWords human scores do not establish an expansion of the underlying coverage.

E2.justification: The corresponding comparisons retain the same single-turn T2I baseline and Ag1, Ag2, and Ag3 prototypes. No evaluated comparator is added or removed.

E3.justification: The 15-turn evaluation, models, caption processing, automatic metrics, and human-rating procedures are retained. Figure 21 already asks about both content and style/aesthetics in v2; separating their results in v3 does not establish a new protocol. The added sample breakdown is newly disclosed detail.

E4.justification: The turn-by-turn analyses, Appendix C dialogue and image examples, and Appendix E.2 experiment filtering ten generated images using agent-user QA pairs are unchanged. No ablation, robustness test, or case study is added or removed.

E5.justification: Both versions report automatic means and standard deviations and retain the same ten-seed experiment in Appendix E.2. No repeated-run disclosure, uncertainty-estimation procedure, or significance test is added or removed; changed deviation values are numerical-result changes.

E6.justification: Table 1 substantially revises the human results: v2 has one rating column with missing ImageInWords entries, whereas v3 reports content and aesthetics separately for all three datasets. On COCO, v2 ranks Ag3 first at 0.2915; v3 ranks Ag3 first for aesthetics at 0.511 but Ag2 first for content at 0.316. These differently specified results are not direct performance gains. Some automatic deviations also change beyond rounding, including ImageInWords Ag2 NLL from 193.7 to 192 and baseline DSG from 0.70 to 0.1.

T1.justification: Appendix B’s agent formalism and objective, Appendix D.2’s heuristic equation, and the NLL independence assumption remain unchanged. No mathematical definition, derivation, or proof is substantively revised.

C1.justification: The introduction removes the claim of strong correlation between automatic and human evaluations establishing the pipeline’s reliability. The main contributions concerning proactive agents, editable belief graphs, automated evaluation, and DesignBench remain unchanged.

C2.justification: Section 7.3 reframes human studies as providing complementary insights instead of verifying automatic evaluations, and removes the statement that human ratings validate DINO results. The existing mechanism explanations and limitations elsewhere are retained.

D1.justification: V3 adds a direct DesignBench dataset-access link in Section 7.1.2. Figure 21 newly discloses 250 ImageInWords, 250 COCO-Captions, and 21 DesignBench examples, whereas v2 only gives approximately 550 pairs per agent. This documents sample composition without explicitly changing the study.

R1.justification: Section 7.1.2 and the bibliography replace Deng’s 2012 MNIST article with the LeCun, Cortes, and Burges 2010 database reference. The broader related-work discussion and research positioning remain unchanged.

P1.justification: V3 makes limited copyedits and explanatory refinements, including clearer prompt terminology, the cuisine-attribute example, and the Easy-to-Answer discussion. It also updates front matter, acknowledgements, and reference capitalization. The section and appendix organization is retained.

P2.justification: Table 1 is relocated within page 13 and restructured with reordered metrics and two human-evaluation columns. Figure 4 gains panel labels, several captions are edited, and Figure 21’s results reference is corrected from Figure 4 to Table 1. Other visual content remains substantially unchanged.

improvement.justification: V3 improves transparency by distinguishing content from aesthetics, supplying missing ImageInWords human ratings, and moderating the automatic–human agreement claim. The dataset link and sample breakdown also improve documentation. These gains are limited by unexplained numerical revisions and lingering prose referring to a single Human Rating column.
